title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Runs His Own Life
caption:
9 signs a godly man runs his own life.

(Not the other way around.)

He decides what he eats before he's hungry. He puts the phone in another room before it decides for him. He tells his money where to go before it tells him where it went.

Whoever has no rule over his own spirit is like a broken-down city (Proverbs 25:28). Every one of these is a decision made ahead of time, not a willpower contest in the moment.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline #proverbs
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
